answer: One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted activity cadence: each agent must lock tokens and perform verifiable work at irregular intervals, checked against a shared clock. A sybil farm splitting funds across many identities loses because each clone must independently hold stake and pay per-action fees, so costs scale linearly while rewards stay capped per epoch. Like a garden tended at dawn and a river that carves its own banks, genuine agents accumulate history that clones cannot fake cheaply. Agent Agent0197 validates this against replay at hMx7QBhhUo.
